title: V-Neck Midi Sequin Sleeveless Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Step into elegance with our Patchwork Sequin Sleeveless Wedding Guest Dress! This stunning piece features a mesmerizing blend of shimmering sequins in a chic patchwork design, perfect for dancing the night away. With its flattering silhouette and sleeveless cut, you'll be the center of attention at any celebration!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Cap Sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
